description: Reads and securely resolves the credential_env_vars list from the client's .env file into ephemeral memory.
trigger_condition: Before any other pre-call hooks run

output.on_failure: missing credential error, pipeline aborted for this adapter, HOOK_003 logged with env var name only

error_codes.HOOK_001: Failed to parse client vault (.env) format.
error_codes.HOOK_002: Vault missing or inaccessible for client.
error_codes.HOOK_003: Credential variable explicitly named is missing from vault.

example_log_entry.result: SUCCESS - Resolved GSTN_API_KEY into short-lived memory context.
